"""Finding the stretches of opening hours that nobody covers."""

import hourglass.parsing
import hourglass.models
import hourglass.merging
import hourglass.errors


def check_within(worked, hours) -> None:
    """Raise OutsideHoursError for the first span not inside opening hours."""
    # Every worked span has to sit fully inside opening hours.
    for span in worked:
        if span.start < hours.start or span.end > hours.end:
            text = hourglass.parsing.format_span(span)
            raise hourglass.errors.OutsideHoursError(f"outside hours: {text}")


def uncovered_spans(worked, hours) -> list:
    """The holes in opening hours, as spans in time order."""
    merged = hourglass.merging.merge_spans(worked)
    edges = [hours.start] + [p for s in merged for p in (s.start, s.end)]
    edges.append(hours.end)
    pairs = zip(edges[0::2], edges[1::2])
    return [hourglass.models.Span(left, right) for left, right in pairs if left < right]


def find_gaps(worked, hours) -> list:
    """One label per uncovered stretch, such as 'gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)'."""
    worked = list(worked)
    check_within(worked, hours)
    spans = uncovered_spans(worked, hours)
    return [
        f"gap {hourglass.parsing.format_span(span)} ({span.minutes} min)"
        for span in spans
    ]
EOF
cat > tests/test_gaps.py <<'EOF'
import unittest

import hourglass.parsing
import hourglass.gaps
import hourglass.errors

HOURS = hourglass.parsing.parse_span("09:00-17:00")


def gaps_for(*texts):
    spans = [hourglass.parsing.parse_span(text) for text in texts]
    return hourglass.gaps.find_gaps(spans, HOURS)


class GapTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_middle_gap_label(self):
        """A hole between two spans is labelled with its length."""
        self.assertEqual(
            gaps_for("09:00-12:00", "13:00-17:00"), ["gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)"]
        )

    def test_nobody_working(self):
        """With no spans the whole day is one gap."""
        self.assertEqual(gaps_for(), ["gap 09:00-17:00 (480 min)"])

    def test_full_cover_has_no_gaps(self):
        """Touching spans that fill the day leave nothing."""
        self.assertEqual(gaps_for("09:00-13:00", "13:00-17:00"), [])

    def test_overlaps_do_not_hide_gaps(self):
        """Overlapping spans are merged before gaps are found."""
        self.assertEqual(
            gaps_for("09:00-12:00", "10:00-11:00", "14:00-17:00"),
            ["gap 12:00-14:00 (120 min)"],
        )

    def test_edge_gaps_count(self):
        """Gaps at the start and end of opening hours are reported."""
        self.assertEqual(
            gaps_for("10:00-16:00"),
            ["gap 09:00-10:00 (60 min)", "gap 16:00-17:00 (60 min)"],
        )

    def test_early_start_raises(self):
        """A span starting before opening raises."""
        with self.assertRaises(hourglass.errors.OutsideHoursError):
            gaps_for("08:00-12:00")

    def test_late_end_raises(self):
        """A span ending after closing raises."""
        with self.assertRaises(hourglass.errors.OutsideHoursError):
            gaps_for("12:00-18:00")
EOF
